Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 33 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Shalini - 32 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Pallavi - 62 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Rajesh - 49 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Ajay stands on the training ground. Shalini, Pallavi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[Ajay practises sword fighting.]

Pallavi (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Ajay draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Ajay: "What happened?"

[Ajay shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Ajay: "Shalini, look at this."

[Shalini rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Rajesh (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Shalini stands in the courtyard. Ajay stands near her.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Shalini washes clothes in a bucket.]

Shalini: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Ajay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Ajay (gently): "Yes, all right."

[Ajay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Shalini (excited): "Ajay, look at this."

Scene 4: The bathroom - Day

[Ajay stands in the bathroom. Pallavi, Shalini and Rajesh stand near him.]

Ajay: "What a nice place."

[Ajay shaves in front of the mirror.]

Ajay: "That was such a fun day!"
